els.description: Strange's Lock. Built for batteau boats around the 1830's. The wooden sides of the lock have been preserved at the water level.
els.name: Strange's Lock

els.description: Ruins of the lock, a mill, and the piers from a burned down covered bridge are all in this area.
els.name: Palmyra Mill Lock

els.description: Stone and timbers in the riverbed are the remains of the 1830's lock and dam.
els.name: Broken Island Locks and Dam

els.description: The remains of wood framing and planking backed by thick stonewalls are visible on the river bottom when the river is low.
els.name: Crofton Lock

els.description: Circa 1796. The Rivanna lock is visible jutting out of the north bank of the river. A stone wall in the river is possibly the remains of a bridge. On the south bank is the remains of Union Mills Lock.
els.name: Union Mills Lock

els.description: Dam ruins in the river. The lock in this area is built from both quarried stone and natural bedrock.
els.name: Union Mills Dam
